description: AutoPilot runs the AI Text Generator with Claude, but the user has no Anthropic key, so the block answers with a sign-in card and AutoPilot stops. The user starts adding a key on the connect card, cancels, and asks AutoPilot to skip it instead; AutoPilot answers that message once, saying it couldn't go on, and nothing else runs. copilot-connect-card-journey.spec.ts follows it.
title: A line about the sea

turns.text: I'll write that line with the AI Text Generator, using Claude.

turns.text: It needs your Anthropic API key first. Connect one on the card and I'll carry on.
